## About Me

I am a researcher at [MDRC](https://www.mdrc.org/about/people/ben-wallace) based in San Francisco. I use mixed methods to study criminal justice reform and anti-poverty programs. 

Before MDRC, I graduated with a B.A. in a program at the intersection of sociology, ethnic studies, and history from Duke University. Read more about it [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/17N7oFHydCEBg0QAvFhHnpAuuQwTG5Xh3/view?usp=sharing).

Outside of research, I love going to jazz concerts, reading, and exploring the Bay Area's amazing scenery.
